item.title: Be The Media! Workshop: WAKE
item.description: Wednesday / September 23, 2026 at 5:00 pm Join composer Micaela Tobin, choreographer Jay Carlon, and their team for a Be the Media! workshop at The Sanctuary in North Troy. The workshop includes screening video material from WAKE, a celebratory ritual for grief that centers queer Filipino life through a combination of sound, dance, and video projection. Workshop with Jay Carlon and Micaela Tobin

item.title: A Control-Theoretic Perspective on Game-Theoretic Learning
item.description: ISE The framework of multi-agent game-theoretic learning explores how individual agent strategies evolve in response to the strategies of others. A central question is whether these evolving strategies converge to classical solution concepts, such as Nash equilibrium. This talk adopts a control-theoretic perspective by recognizing that learning agents interacting with one another form a feedback system. item.title: September 23rd Cognitive Science Seminar with Dr. Sanjay Oruganti
item.description: Please join the Cognitive Science Department on Wednesday, September 23rd, for a presentation by Dr. Sanjay Oruganti, Research Scientist in the Language, Embodiment, Intelligence, Agency (LEIA) Lab in the Cognitive Science Department at RPI.
